## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-06-09 — do not edit manually*

### timeout not on PATH
*~200 tokens/session saved*
- `timeout` command is not available on macOS. Do NOT prefix commands with `timeout N`.
- Run `npx tsc -b` or `npm run check` directly without a timeout wrapper.

### Check/test output pattern
*~300 tokens/session saved*
- Capture output: `npm run check > /tmp/check.log 2>&1`
- Parse result: `grep -iE 'Test Files|Tests |passed|failed|vuln' /tmp/check.log`

### Read before Edit
*~300 tokens/session saved*
- Always Read a file in the same turn (or earlier) before calling Edit.
- Skipping emits `File has not been read yet.` and wastes a full tool round-trip.

### Shell portability
*~200 tokens/session saved*
- `gh` CLI is not on PATH. Use `git` remote commands for GitHub operations.
- `grep --include=*.ts` on zsh expands the glob — always quote: `grep --include='*.ts' ...`.

<!-- headroom:learn:end -->
